primary_T.label: primary CD4+ T cell
primary_T.note: Direct hit: CL:0000624 'CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell' (bulk CD4+ alpha-beta T). Proxies: CL:0000895 (naive thymus-derived CD4+ alpha-beta T) and CL:0000897 (CD4+ alpha-beta memory T) together span the CD4+ compartment that donor PBMC CD4+ magnetic-bead enrichment yields, matching the Ho 2025 sort. Treg (CL:0000792) and effector subsets (CL:0000904/0905/1044) are intentionally excluded as specialized lineages. CL:0000492 'CD4+ helper T cell' is biologically meaningful but AlphaGenome does not publish tracks under it; validated against the live catalog on 2026-10-20 via scripts/validate_alphagenome_ontology.py.

jurkat.label: Jurkat T lymphoblast cell line
jurkat.note: EFO:0002796 is 'Jurkat' in EFO; CLO:0007045 is 'Jurkat, Clone E6-1', the ATCC clone used in Siraj 2026 and other Jurkat screens. Both are direct hits for the Jurkat cell line; no proxy is biologically appropriate for an immortalized leukemic T-cell line. The previously declared EFO:0001083 and CL:0000912 are not in AlphaGenome's catalog (verified via scripts/validate_alphagenome_ontology.py on 2026-10-20).

rough_soft_ai_rejected_variant_value.note: Rough-soft AI must output a number for every held-out variant. For variants where the VPRS lower approximation is empty (model declines), we define the Rough-soft AI prediction to equal the source-context effect (Jurkat), i.e. 'no evidence of a cell-type change'. This is a definition of the Rough-soft AI method, not an error fallback.

evaluation.expert_alone_selection_note: Expert-alone selects its own B variants to review using a non-VPRS rule, so that the Expert-alone vs Neurojico comparison tests whether VPRS boundary selection beats a reasonable uncertainty-blind selection rule under the same reviewed-variant budget.
